answer_summary.structure_O: unit1 = -CH=CH2 (Swern oxidation of the free CH2OH of N, then Wittig methylenation); units 2-6 = -CH2OBn; secondary rim (OBn)12
answer_summary.structure_P: alkene-directed (ortho, 1,2-clockwise per the 9.8 convention) DIBAL-H debenzylation frees unit 2; MsCl/NaN3 turns it into -CH2N3. unit1 = -CH=CH2; unit2 = -CH2N3; units 3-6 = -CH2OBn
answer_summary.structure_Q: 2 equiv DIBAL-H reduce the unit-2 azide to -CH2NH2 (protic director) and debenzylate the amine's 1,4-unit = unit 5; NaH and ClCH2-C(=CH2)-CH2Cl double-alkylate OH(5)/NH2(2) into the -CH2-NH-CH2-C(=CH2)-CH2-O- bridge between units 2 and 5. unit1 = -CH=CH2; unit2 = bridge N-arm (cap H); unit5 = bridge O-arm; units 3, 4, 6 = -CH2OBn
answer_summary.structure_R: bridge NH is protic; its 1,4-unit (unit 5) is occupied by the bridge, so the stated 1,3-counterclockwise fallback frees unit 6; Boc2O protects the bridge nitrogen; MsCl/NaN3 install -CH2N3 at unit 6. unit1 = -CH=CH2; unit2 = bridge N-arm (cap Boc); unit5 = bridge O-arm; unit6 = -CH2N3; units 3, 4 = -CH2OBn
answer_summary.structure_S: TFA removes Boc, NaH/BnI N-benzylates the bridge nitrogen; final 2 equiv DIBAL-H reduce the unit-6 azide to -CH2NH2 and debenzylate the 1,4-unit of the new amine at unit 6 = unit 3 (the rival director NHBn@2 has both targets blocked: 1,4 = unit 5 bridge, 1,3-ccw = unit 6 amine). unit1 = -CH=CH2; unit2 = bridge N-arm (cap Bn); unit3 = -CH2OH; unit4 = -CH2OBn; unit5 = bridge O-arm; unit6 = -CH2NH2. The six boxes are pairwise distinct (hexadifferentiated), matching the problem preamble.

assumptions: Trusted general chemistry (ordinary scientific references, not competition answers): Swern oxidation CH2OH->CHO; Wittig methylenation CHO->CH=CH2; MsCl/NaN3 as CH2OH->CH2N3 via SN2; Boc2O protects a secondary amine and TFA removes it; NaH-promoted double alkylation of an OH/NH2 pair with a dichloride; DIBAL-H reduces alkyl azides to primary amines (justification of the 2-equiv. steps, forced by the downstream Boc2O step which requires an N-H); isolated C=C groups are untouched by DIBAL-H.

All directing rules actually used for regiochemistry are printed in the problem: Sinay protic 1,4 direction with 1,3 fallback when 1,4 is unavailable; Sollogoub alkene ortho (1,2) direction; the 9.8 convention 1,2 = clockwise, 1,3 = counterclockwise; protic groups stronger than alkenes.
Starting material N read directly from the printed figure: unit 1 = CH2OH, units 2-6 = CH2OBn, secondary rim (OBn)12.
Blank answer sheets A9-4/A9-5 (theory_problem.pdf PDF pages 92-93) confirm the six numbered boxes and the preprinted (OBn)12 on each of the five templates O-S.
